messages:
Ana Torres: Quick thread - coordinating SI + hardware reseller claims for the upcoming co-sell with TitanHW. Need a deterministic way to map accounts so the reseller, SI, and Redwood AEs don't fight over credit.
Ben Wu: Agreed. Marketplace leads sometimes get routed to the reseller and the SI at the same time. Proposal: introduce an 'ownership_fingerprint' = sha1(acct_id + partner_id + origin) stored on the claim to detect dupes.
Priya Malhotra: Love the fingerprint idea. Operational rules: (1) first valid fingerprint wins; (2) 24h evidence window to upload discovery notes or recording; (3) if prior_owner exists and objects, escalate to partnerships@redwood with 12h SLA.
Kofi Mensah: Edge case: hardware partner also owns relationship (reseller). For those, set role=reseller_primary and SI gets co-sell credit only if SI runs tech demo and attaches evidence. Need `reseller_primary` flag.
ownership-bot: claim-service: fingerprint recorded for ACCT-9001 -> fp=2b6f9a... status=pending evidence_deadline=+24h
Ana Torres: UI/CLI for partners: `/claim-fp --acct=ACCT-9001 --partner=titanhw --origin=marketplace` returns fp and status. If conflict, return existing fp + owner info.
Ben Wu: CSV / reconciliation fields: acct_id, fp, partner, role, claim_ts, evidence_present, prior_owner, demo_hold, last_event_ts, audit_url. Make daily export at 5am PT.
Priya Malhotra: Demo gating: if demo_hold=true (legal/po pending), block scheduler and show modal with contact partnerships@redwood. Also require SI to attach a short test plan for hardware demos (hardware demos risk).
Kofi Mensah: For split-credit with reseller+SI, record split percentages and primary_owner for renewal. Example: split=si:30,reseller:40,redwood:30; primary_owner=redwood-AE-12. Primary owner gets renewal ownership, splits only affect payout.
ownership-bot: claim-service: event=auto_assign fp=2b6f9a... -> assigned=emea-region-ae-07 reason=stale-30h
Ana Torres: Timing rules: 24h evidence window, 30h auto-assign to region AE, 7d orphan -> partnerships alert. Contested claims require manager approval within 12h or default to prior owner.
Ben Wu: Action items: (1) ENGINEERING - add fingerprint field + CLI endpoint; (2) MARKETPLACE - surface reseller badge + demo_hold tooltip; (3) PARTNERSHIPS - publish one-pager with timers and reclaim flow.
Priya Malhotra: I'll draft the one-pager and sample CSV schema. Please include example payloads for engineers.
Kofi Mensah: Also add a short checklist for hardware demos: NDA, access to on-prem kit, engineer POC, safety checklist. Partners must confirm before scheduling.
Ana Torres: Thanks team. If we can ship fingerprint + demo gating before the TitanHW announce, we should avoid duplicated outreach and protect hardware inventory for demos. Drop Confluence link here when ready. :lock:
